# DreamWork Renovations

> Kitchen, bath & home remodeling based in Spring, Texas. Blaga and Sukh remodel kitchens, baths, floors and fireplaces around The Woodlands and Spring. Reviewers praise the clear communication, perfectionist tile work and a home left spotless at the end of each day.

- Phone: (346) 661-2321

## Services
- Bathroom remodeling: Custom tile showers, tubs and vanities, waterproofed properly underneath.
- Kitchen remodeling: Cabinets, countertops, backsplashes and layout changes planned with you.
- Fireplaces & built-ins: Stacked stone and tile surrounds, painted brick and built-in media walls.
- Flooring & tile: Tile, LVP and laminate installed over a sound subfloor.
- Painting, drywall & repairs: Interior paint, sheetrock and ceiling repair, leaks and water damage.
- Real-estate prep: Pre-listing updates and inspection repairs for homeowners, agents and investors.

## About
DreamWork Renovations is run by a husband-and-wife team. Blaga handles planning and communication, so you always know what is happening next. Sukh leads the work on site, bringing more than 20 years of hands-on remodeling experience from London and Texas. Their work runs from full kitchen and bath remodels to stacked stone fireplaces, floors, paint and leak repairs. Projects often start with a material board, with cabinet doors, hardware, tile and flooring picked together with the client.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can I get a quote without an in-person visit?
  A: Often, yes. Text or message photos of the space and what you need, and DreamWork can quote from those. One reviewer got a sheetrock quote that way without lining up several contractors.
- Q: Do you work with realtors and investors?
  A: Yes. DreamWork handles pre-listing updates and inspection repairs, with a pay-at-closing option.
- Q: Is the work warranted?
  A: Major remodels come with a 1-year workmanship warranty, and the company is fully insured.
- Q: Do you offer financing?
  A: Yes. Financing is available through DreamWork's lending partners.
- Q: Can we stay at home during a remodel?
  A: Reviewers say the crew keeps dust down, respects your space and leaves everything clean at the end of each day. One family with two kids and a dog said the team worked around them with no trouble.
- Q: Which areas do you serve?
  A: Based in Spring, DreamWork works across The Woodlands, Conroe, Magnolia, Tomball and Willis.
